mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", project_id AS "projectId", department_id AS "departmentId", period AS "period", contract_base AS "contractBase", attribution_ratio AS "attributionRatio", dq_status AS "dqStatus" FROM ecos_dw.ecos_biz_stage_fact WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND dq_status <> 'REJECTED' AND project_id = #{projectId} AND period = #{period} ORDER BY project_id ASC, period ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS "id", project_id AS "projectId", contract_id AS "contractId", department_id AS "departmentId", attribution_ratio AS "attributionRatio", effective_from AS "effectiveFrom", effective_to AS "effectiveTo" FROM ecos_dw.ecos_biz_project_attribution WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND is_active = 1 AND project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY project_id ASC, effective_from ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
